rows.label: tlk43200144_04_msg0001
rows.name:
The grand stairs at the Holy Gate of
Fontana are impressive, but so are the
stairs down from Sevind Palace Plaza!

rows.label: tlk43200144_04_msg0002
rows.name:
I hear they lead to a place called
the Perla Fountain Park Ruins.
But I doubt I could make it...

rows.label: tlk43200144_04_msg0003
rows.name:
You might be able to, if you could
jump a really long way... But for me,
it'd spell broken bones for sure!
